description: Connects Stripe through Gemmein's own one-purpose page — a restricted key is never typed into a chat. Answers one state: connected (which Stripe account, test or live mode), waiting (the page's link for your human: it opens Stripe's key page with every permission already ticked, Development's also ticking the two test-payment rows, then they paste the key there and Gemmein checks it on the spot), broken (the connected key was rolled or lost a permission — with a fresh page), expired, cancelled or revoked (nothing changed), or not_live (Live's key comes after go-live). A refused paste says exactly why — a live key in Development, a named missing permission, a key that can do too much — and what your human does next. wait: up to 40 seconds, answering the moment it changes — send the link, then call again with wait: 40; never ask your human to say when they're done. env live: Live's key, which asks for the code Gemmein emails on the page. plans: true when the app will sell subscriptions (the link then asks for the two plan permissions up front). Calling again never opens a second page. This is what a founder may call setting up payments or getting paid.

plans.description: the app sells subscriptions: ask for the two plan permissions now

wait.description: seconds to wait for your human (0-40); the answer comes the moment it changes
